$description: Citation ledger. Every path:line[-line] citation used anywhere in this repo has an entry here with the text expected at that range; verify_all.py resolves each one (range AND content) when the sibling source tree is present and WARNs-and-skips when it is not.
pathBase: Citations are relative to the project root that holds design-repo/ as a sibling (src/, recon/, CLONE_SPEC.md, package.json). Not included in this package.

evidenceKinds.measured-live-spec: CLONE_SPEC.md: values Playwright-measured against the live original on 2026-10-22 (1280x800 and 390x844) or read from the original's client bundle.
evidenceKinds.measured-live-raw: recon/*: raw measurement files (char counts, boxes, network list, scoped style blocks).
evidenceKinds.built-source: src/, tailwind.config.js, package.json: the clone as built. Records what the clone does, which is not always what the live site does.
